content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the improper handling of the request list when a command preparation fails. Specifically, when the preparation for a request failed, the subsequent requests in the list were orphaned and not properly tracked, leading to attempts to submit an unprepared command. This occurred because the logic did not correctly update the request list to reflect the failure, resulting in a disconnection between the original request list and the failed request. The patch fixes this by using request list helper functions to properly manage the list and ensure that all requests are correctly tracked and submitted.
